title: A callable signature with a trailing colon needs a return type

ground_truth.statement: Closure(int): starts a callable return-type clause but supplies no type. The documented callable grammar requires a return type there. A complete Closure():void control is well formed. Runtime establishes that PHP ignores both docblocks.

allowed.reason: A second parser-layer report of the same incomplete callable return clause, not an independent false positive.

provenance.note: Re-derived incomplete callable-return annotation and added a well-formed closure control.

notes: This row measures annotation syntax policy. All three tools diagnose the incomplete clause. Mago emits both invalid-docblock and malformed-docblock-comment at line 3, which identify the same syntax error; the latter is acknowledged with an exact code and line. A missing grammar diagnostic would not establish a runtime defect or non-support.
